title: Local - Local WordPress development made simple

facts.fact: The vendor states that Local is free to download and will always remain free.
facts.quote: It’s free and always will be.

facts.fact: The vendor states that Local is only available as a desktop application and not on mobile devices.
facts.quote: Local is only available as a desktop application, but no worries!

facts.fact: The vendor states that Local's automatic WordPress installation takes one click and includes SSL.
facts.quote: One click and your site is ready to go, SSL included!

facts.fact: The vendor lists Mac Intel, Mac Apple Silicon, Windows, and Linux (Debian-based and RPM-based) as platform options in its download form.
facts.quote: Please choose your platform Mac Intel Mac Apple Silicon Windows Linux - Debian based (Ubuntu, etc) Linux RPM based- (Fedora, Red Hat Linux, CentOS)

facts.fact: The vendor's download form offers three organization types: Agency, Independent Freelancer/Consultant, and Other.
facts.quote: Please choose your organization type Agency Independent Freelancer/Consultant Other

facts.fact: The vendor says Local Cloud Backups let users push and pull sites to Google Drive or Dropbox.
facts.quote: the ability to easily push and pull sites from Local to Google Drive or Dropbox.

facts.fact: The vendor says Live Links create persistent URLs for sending local WordPress sites to clients and coworkers without deploying.
facts.quote: Create persistent URLs to send your local WordPress sites to clients and coworkers without deploying.

facts.fact: The vendor states that Local offers root SSH access, WP-CLI, and the ability to hot-swap PHP environments.
facts.quote: Local offers root SSH access, WP-CLI, and the ability to hot-swap PHP environments for easy testing!
